I also couldn't check who owns Thornbury, because I can't see any account files for it.

I've sent June a direct message with the details and logged the approval request. Once she or Anselm says yes, I'll save the draft to Hollis (hmbeki@pemberline.com) with the subject "Thornbury 2027 rate" and the $2,101/seat figure, for you to send yourself.
